purpose: GOV-01 source of truth for assets eligible for the clean public repository; GOV-02 must copy only listed paths and must still apply GOV-03 license files.

release_notice_template.rule: GOV-02 copies LICENSE, DATA_LICENSE and NOTICE to the root of the new public repository without changing their legal text; these templates do not license the private integration repository.

owner_decision.third_party_rule: Do not redistribute unless this manifest explicitly lists the asset and its attribution obligation.

approved_assets.origin: Project-generated fixed-seed demonstration data; no real observations

approved_assets.attribution: Source: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI), Integrated Surface Database.

approved_assets.origin: Project-owned deployed multistep_v2 weight approved by the owner
approved_assets.attribution: Qiongyu Zhixi contributors; retain the paired manifest and model limitations.

approved_assets.origin: Paired artifact for the approved multistep_v2 weight
approved_assets.attribution: Qiongyu Zhixi contributors; must be distributed only with the paired manifest.

approved_assets.origin: Machine-readable provenance for the approved multistep_v2 package
approved_assets.attribution: Qiongyu Zhixi contributors; it records protocol, validation metrics and excluded training-data hashes.

code_policy.rule: Project-authored code may be selected by GOV-02, except the explicitly excluded files; third-party dependency licenses remain separate.

excluded_paths.reason: Derived from CNEMC mirror data with unverified redistribution terms.
Real pollution observations; upstream redistribution terms are unverified.
CNEMC mirror archives are not a recorded redistribution license.
Official documents and API snapshots are cited by URL, not republished without specific terms.
Do not bulk-copy third-party source payloads; the two manifest files are separately approved as metadata.
Superseded or research-only weights; not approved product releases.
Pre-audit artifacts with invalidated time handling.
Research-only models without completed same-protocol acceptance.
Research-only model without complete data-hash provenance.
Local smoke artifacts are not releases.
Private historical material, caches and invalidated artifacts.
Third-party competition material is not republished by the project.

required_release_checks: Copy only approved assets and code selected under code_policy into a fresh directory; never clone or push this private history to open.
Reject absolute paths, __pycache__, runtime state and every excluded path after staging.
Keep mandatory NOAA NCEI attribution for weather.csv and the synthetic-data disclosure for pollution.csv.
Treat model manifest data hashes as provenance only: the referenced real training corpora remain excluded.
